draft.name: Weekly finished tickets summary
draft.purpose: Looks at the Jira tickets finished this week in one project and proposes a summary ticket for the team.
good_for: Summarise what we finished this week
Make a weekly report of finished Jira tickets
Tell the team what was closed in a project

inputs.name: Jira project
inputs.what: The project to summarise, and where the summary ticket goes.

blocks.say: Find the tickets in the project that were finished since last Friday.
Group them by what they were about and write a short summary.
Propose one ticket that lists the summary.

approvals.why: It writes a new ticket that the team will read.

missing_tools.need: Post the summary in a Teams channel
missing_tools.why: No tool posts in Teams yet, so the summary goes in a Jira ticket.

questions: Which Jira project should the summary cover?
